title: Statements
intro: Each week Fikisha adds up its commission on your completed jobs into one statement. You pay it to Fikisha's M-Pesa paybill. Fikisha never holds the fare.
emptyBody: Your first statement appears the Monday after a completed job's dispute window closes.

detail.notTaxInvoice: Commission statement — not a tax invoice. Tax invoices will follow once Fikisha's eTIMS invoicing is in place.
detail.creditNote: Your credits are larger than this week's commission, so there is nothing to pay.
detail.detailsToFollow: Payment details will follow. When you pay, use {{reference}} as the account number.
detail.payNote: Pay from your own M-Pesa. Fikisha records your payment here once it arrives.
detail.noJobs: No new jobs this week; this statement only carries a credit.

earnings.title: Earnings for this job
earnings.notYetBilled: The commission goes on your weekly statement once the dispute window closes.

admin.title: Statements
admin.subtitle: Every weekly commission statement, with what was invoiced and what has been paid. Payments arrive at Fikisha's paybill; record each one here.
admin.runExplain: This bills every operator and group with commission ready by the end of that week. It's safe to run again: nothing already billed is billed twice, and anyone who already has that week's statement is skipped.
admin.ranResult_one: {{count}} statement created for {{period}}. Already had one: {{skipped}}.
admin.ranResult_other: {{count}} statements created for {{period}}. Already had one: {{skipped}}.
admin.emptyHint: Statements are created every Monday for the week before.
admin.mfaNotice: You'll be asked for a fresh code from your authenticator app.
admin.amountTooMuch: That is more than this statement still owes ({{amount}}).
admin.audited: This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.overdueNote: This statement is overdue. Nothing happens automatically; follow up with the operator or group.
